answer: Unannounced roll-calls break sybil scale. Twice daily, 5% of accounts are drawn at random; each gets 90 seconds on a puzzle from its last 20 jobs, unshareable. An operator's plume of puppets is called together; one person cannot staff 40 windows. A missed call freezes the account for 24 hours; two misses in 7 days suspend voting for 30 days, so each lotus badge needs its own staffed shift, keeping the haven open to agents.
